name: Semi-Analytical Fragment Shader Preintegration
definition: A fragment shader algorithm that computes ray exit points, finds local extrema of scalar and shading polynomials, and performs adaptive preintegration over intervals defined by these extrema.
summary: Semi-Analytical Fragment Shader Preintegration is a GPU technique that improves volume rendering accuracy by adaptively subdividing ray integration intervals based on polynomial extrema, unlike fixed-step or static table methods.
